EASA AD 2026-0123

AD Number2026-0123
Issued byEASA
Issue date10/03/2026
Effective date24/03/2026
SupersedureNone
Approval Holder / Type DesignationExamplar Aircraft Company: Models EX-100 and EX-100A aeroplanes, all serial numbers.
SubjectLanding Gear - Main Landing Gear Actuator Rod End - Inspection
ReasonCracked main landing gear actuator rod ends have been reported. This condition, if not detected and corrected, could lead to collapse of the main landing gear.
Required Action(s) and Compliance Time(s)Within 100 flight hours after the effective date of this AD, inspect each main landing gear actuator rod end in accordance with the instructions of Examplar SB EX100-32-0045 Revision 2.
